message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant set fire to a rented dormitory due to drug-induced hallucination, causing property damage valued at 4040 yuan. This is arson (故意放火) causing property damage. Also possibly "非法使用毒品" (drug use) but the charge is about the fire. Under Chinese law, arson causing property damage is "放火罪". The value is relatively low, but still arson. Also could be "危害公共安全罪"? But arson in a residential building is "放火罪". Also "吸毒" is a separate offense, but the question asks "这部分事实构成什么罪名？" focusing on the fire. So answer: [罪名]放火罪<eoa>.

Check if multiple charges: maybe also "纵火罪"? In Chinese law, "放火罪" is the term. So final answer: [罪名]放火罪<eoa>.
